instruction: A candid cinematic still, medium close-up shot of a couple outdoors in a grassy field on an overcast day. On the right, the woman with a shaved head (R1) wearing a light pink long-sleeve top holds a red smartphone, looking down at the screen. On the left, the bearded man (R2) wearing a white t-shirt stands close, resting his hand on her shoulder as he looks down at the phone. The background shows a softly blurred grassy hill under diffused, natural daylight with muted colors and soft shadows.
elements: R1 holds the red smartphone while looking down at its screen
R2 stands close to R1 and looks down at the phone R1 is holding
R2 rests his hand on R1's shoulder
the red smartphone is the shared object of attention
the couple is outdoors in a grassy field

questions.element: R2 makes shoulder contact with R1

questions.element: R2 views the phone controlled by R1
